client.business_model: Regional distributor of fresh produce and dairy products to restaurants, schools, hospitals and other institutional food-service customers across the U.S. Southeast.
client.client_history: Royal Food Service was founded in 1994 in Atlanta, Georgia, by Craig Fleming and Mark Whitehurst. Since then it has grown into one of the largest independent fresh-produce distributors in the Southeast, operating several HACCP-certified cold-storage and processing facilities and a fleet of more than 90 refrigerated trucks.

revenue.source: Growjo company profile (75.1 M USD) – corroborated by Leadiq estimate 50-100 M USD; Martini.ai lists 200 M USD which is a significant outlier
revenue.notes: Most third-party data aggregators (Growjo 75.1 M, Leadiq 50-100 M, AllBiz 25-74.9 M) cluster in the ~75 M range, while one source (Martini.ai) reports 200 M. No audited figures are publicly available, so an estimated 75.1 M is reported with low confidence and the wider $50-200 M range is noted.

locations.source: Official company website About page – lists main 74,000 sq ft warehouse at 3720 Zip Industrial Blvd SE and two Royal Fresh Cuts facilities at 3675 and 3600 Zip Industrial Blvd SE, Atlanta GA
locations.notes: All three facilities are in Atlanta; no additional sites are referenced in documents or web sources.

employees.source: AllBiz (approx. 220 at Atlanta facility) and Leadiq (201-203 employees as of Feb 2026)
employees.notes: Both sources show headcount in the low-200s; no official figure on the company website. Averaged to 220 to reflect upper end of the reported range.

extraction_sources: Kickoff/Royal Food Service - Strategic Sourcing Project Kickoff Oct 21 2024.pptx (slides 1-2 confirm official name)
martini.ai research page (200 M revenue outlier)

Revenue estimates vary widely ($50-200 M); majority of sources cluster around $75 M, hence low confidence.
No EBITDA figures located in any document or reputable source.
